<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex21042026-16-45-31" status="unreviewed">
       <milestone n="2nd text: sems sdom pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal ba" unit="section"/>
         'dis 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin grol la 'god par gyur 1 |||
         Bla ma dang dkon mchog 3 la phyag 'tshal lo || mkhyen brtsed kun la khyab pa nam mkha'i dbyings || <rs type="deity">thub pa chen po'i</rs> zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo|| 
         'gro kun phan bde'i gzhir [14a6] gyur bstan pa'i sa|| 
         <rs type="deity">mgon po byams pa</rs>'i zhabs la :| ma rig mun pa sel mdzad pad mo'i gnyen|| 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3756">'phags pa thogs med</rs> zhabs la :| <expan>nyon mongs</expan> gdung ba sel mdzad kun mud gnyen||
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3758">mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen</rs> zhabs la :| tshad med bang rim bzhi ldan lhun [<lb n="14a7"/> po mchog| 
         
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3708">'phags pa rnam grol sde</rs> la :| <expan>yon tan</expan> gting mtha' yangs pa'i rgya mtsho mchog| 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5548">btsun pa rnam grol sde</rs> la :| rnam smin mi re sbyin pa'i gter mnga' ba||
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8107">skyes mchog mchog gi sde</rs> la :| yang srid mi 'dod <expan>tshul khrims</expan> gter chen mnga'| 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7905">rgyal sras 'dul ba'i sde</rs> <lb n="14b1"/> la :|… 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">seng ge bzang po</rs>'i zhabs la :|… 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7789">ku su lu pa</rs>'i zhabs la :|… 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7790">ku su lu pa gnyis pa</rs>'i zhabs la :|… [14b2] sman mchog mnga' 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6840">gser gling pa</rs> yi :|… 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">dpal ldan a ti sha</rs> la :|… 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom ston rin po che</rs> la :|…
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3830">'gro mgon spyan mnga' ba</rs> [14a3] :|…
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3972">rgyal sras char chen pa</rs> la :|… 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3880">gra ston chen po</rs>'i zhabs la :|… 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3976">sangs rgyas sgoM pa</rs>'i zhabs la :| bdag [14a4]med don rtogs seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa'i | 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">'tshams ston chen po</rs>'i zhabs la :|… 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4016">mkhas btsun bsod yes</rs> zhabs la :|… 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">mkhan chen rin po che</rs> la phyag 'tshal lo|| ces 
         byang <lb n="14b5"/></seg></TEI>
